findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink

Untrusted content: ask_pipeworx, deep_research, subscribe, list_subscriptions, recent_alerts, bet_research, polymarket_fill_risk · Private data: ask_pipeworx, search_within, deep_research, validate_claim, bet_research, polymarket_arbitrage, polymarket_kalshi_spread, generate_llms_txt, get_entity_by_id · Public sink: subscribe, polymarket_fill_risk, remember · Destructive: polymarket_edges, generate_llms_txt, remember, recall, forget.
